title: Aliyun DAMO Academy Launches the 2027 Ali Star Program, Open to 15 AI Frontier Research Topics
excerpt: Today, Alibaba DAMO Academy announced the "Ali Star" top talent recruitment and training program for the 2027 university graduates, and opened up 15 cutting-edg
content_html:
Today, Alibaba DAMO Academy announced the "Ali Star" top talent recruitment and training program for the 2027 university graduates, and opened up 15 cutting-edge research topics covering directions such as AI chips, new CPU architectures, medical multimodal agents, and AGI decision-making, aiming to attract outstanding talents from universities to participate in the exploration of next-generation artificial intelligence technologies.

In the field of chips, DAMO Academy has laid out multiple research directions around AI computing infrastructure, including the design of AI chip programming models, development of AI compilers, research on AI SoC architecture for large model training and inference, and optimization of AI chip inference systems. These studies will involve key technologies such as self-developed AI chip programming languages, compiler toolchains, hardware-software collaborative optimization, advanced packaging, and system architecture design.

In addition, DAMO Academy is also focusing on the evolution of computing architectures in the Agent era, launching the AI Agent CPU architecture exploration topic, researching the next-generation RISC-V high-performance CPU design direction, analyzing the characteristics of agent workloads, and exploring new micro-architectures suitable for Agentic AI. At the same time, the team will also carry out AI-driven RISC-V compilation optimization research, using AI models to enhance the intelligence level of compilation systems, and participate in related international standard exploration.

In the AI application direction, DAMO Academy focuses on medical AI, multimodal agents, and general AI technologies. The relevant topics include a basic large model for medical imaging, a medical multimodal agent, a medical vision large model, and AI Agent development, with the goal of solving practical clinical problems such as disease diagnosis and medical data analysis through large models, reinforcement learning, and agent technologies.

At the same time, DAMO Academy is also conducting AGI decision-making technology research for the industrial field, exploring the application of long-term memory, self-cognition modeling, continuous learning, and autonomous agent capabilities in scenarios such as energy, aviation, high-speed rail, and ports, and promoting the development of AI video cutting-edge algorithm standards and productization implementation.

This "Ali Star" program covers the complete technical chain from the underlying chip architecture to industry intelligent applications, reflecting that the competition in the AI industry is expanding from model capabilities to full-stack technological system construction, including chips, software ecosystems, and intelligent agent applications.

content_html_zh:
今天，阿里巴巴达摩院宣布面向2027届大学毕业生“阿里星”顶尖人才招聘培养计划，开放15个前沿研究课题，涵盖AI芯片、新型CPU架构、医疗多模态智能体、AGI决策等方向，旨在吸引高校优秀人才参与下一代人工智能技术的探索。

在芯片领域，达摩院围绕AI计算基础设施布局了多个研究方向，包括AI芯片编程模型设计、AI编译器开发、大模型训练和推理的AI SoC架构研究、AI芯片推理系统优化等。 这些研究将涉及自主研发的AI芯片编程语言、编译工具链、软硬件协同优化、先进封装、系统架构设计等关键技术。

此外，达摩院还关注Agent时代计算架构的演进，推出AI Agent CPU架构探索课题，研究下一代RISC-V高性能CPU设计方向，分析Agent工作负载特点，探索适合Agentic AI的新型微架构。 同时，团队还将开展AI驱动的RISC-V编译优化研究，利用AI模型提升编译系统的智能化水平，并参与相关国际标准探索。

在AI应用方向上，达摩院重点关注医疗AI、多模态智能体、通用AI技术。 相关主题包括医学影像基础大模型、医学多模态智能体、医学视觉大模型、AI Agent开发等，旨在通过大模型、强化学习、智能体技术解决疾病诊断、医学数据分析等临床实际问题。

同时，达摩院也在开展面向工业领域的AGI决策技术研究，探索长时记忆、自我认知建模、持续学习、自主代理能力在能源、航空、高铁、港口等场景的应用，推动AI视频前沿算法标准制定和产品化落地。

此次“阿里之星”计划涵盖了从底层芯片架构到行业智能应用的完整技术链，体现了AI行业的竞争正在从模型能力扩展到芯片、软件生态、智能代理应用等全栈技术体系建设。
